title: A 1.5 cm Ant Sends More Tasmanians to Hospital Than Honeybees
subject: jack jumper ant

scenes.text: One tiny ant puts more Tasmanians in hospital than honeybees do.
The jack jumper ant is barely 1.5 centimeters long.
It stings again and again, and it hunts huntsman spiders much bigger than itself.
At Royal Hobart Hospital, its stings caused 21 to 25 percent of the severe allergic reactions treated with adrenaline.
About 3 percent of Tasmanians are at risk. An ant is the creature doctors there fear most.

description:
One tiny ant puts more Tasmanians in hospital than honeybees do.
The jack jumper ant is under 1.5 centimeters, yet its stings caused 21 to 25 percent of severe allergic reactions at one hospital, against 13 percent for honeybees.
Would you have guessed an ant?
first_comment: Ants or bees: which one would you rather run from?
